UPDATE fidelite.messages SET tentatives = tentatives + 1
WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id FROM fidelite.messages
    WHERE tentatives < 5
      AND ((statut = 'a_envoyer' AND fidelite.envoi_autorise(canal))
        OR (statut = 'a_envoyer' AND type = 'campagne' AND fidelite.campagne_autorisee(donnees))
        OR (statut = 'simule' AND apercu_envoye_le IS NULL AND fidelite.apercu_autorise(canal)))
    ORDER BY cree_le
    LIMIT 60
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
RETURNING id, canal, destinataire, sujet, corps, type, tentatives, statut, donnees,
          fidelite.cfg_txt('expediteur') AS expediteur,
          CASE WHEN statut = 'simule' THEN fidelite.cfg_txt('email_test') END AS email_test

UPDATE fidelite.messages SET erreur = NULL, apercu_envoye_le = CASE WHEN statut = 'simule' THEN now() ELSE apercu_envoye_le END, envoye_le = CASE WHEN statut = 'simule' THEN envoye_le ELSE now() END, statut = CASE WHEN statut = 'simule' THEN 'simule' ELSE 'envoye' END WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE fidelite.messages SET statut = CASE WHEN statut = 'simule' THEN 'simule' WHEN tentatives >= 5 THEN 'echec' ELSE 'a_envoyer' END, erreur = left($2, 500) WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE fidelite.messages SET statut = 'echec', erreur = 'SMS non activé : pas encore de passerelle SMS Le Rebond' WHERE id = $1::uuid
